title: A calendar reminder that also does the work.

A scheduled task is a saved prompt that Claude runs on a frequency: hourly, daily, weekdays, weekly or manual. Its prompt calls your skill and reads through your connectors.
A reminder that only reminds you…

title: It runs remotely. Each run starts fresh.
kit: It runs remotely. Each run starts fresh.

A task that uses Drive runs even when your laptop is closed. A task that needs files on your laptop runs only there. Each run is its own session. Do not rely on it to recall the last run: the prompt, the skill and the folders must say everything.
